mapper.select: SELECT recommendation_id, user_id, recommend_date, situation, reason, unwell, created_at FROM recommendations WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND recommend_date = #{recommendDate} ORDER BY created_at DESC, recommendation_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommendations (user_id, recommend_date, situation, reason, unwell) VALUES (#{userId}, #{recommendDate}, #{situation}, #{reason}, #{unwell})
INSERT INTO recommendation_items (recommendation_id, clothes_id, role, reason) VALUES (#{recommendationId}, #{clothesId}, #{role}, #{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT i.recommendation_id, i.clothes_id, i.role, i.reason FROM recommendation_items i JOIN recommendations r ON r.recommendation_id = i.recommendation_id WHERE i.recommendation_id = #{recommendationId} AND r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY i.role, i.clothes_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommendation_weathers (recommendation_id, seq, moment, place_id, weather_snapshot_id, required_clo, is_deciding) VALUES (#{recommendationId}, #{seq}, #{moment}, #{placeId}, #{weatherSnapshotId}, #{requiredClo}, #{isDeciding})
mapper.select: SELECT w.recommendation_id, w.seq, w.moment, w.place_id, w.weather_snapshot_id, w.required_clo, w.is_deciding FROM recommendation_weathers w JOIN recommendations r ON r.recommendation_id = w.recommendation_id WHERE w.recommendation_id = #{recommendationId} AND r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY w.seq
